messages:
Maya (Support): heads up — a customer is seeing negative tokens/sec values in the Streaming metrics panel for their realtime stream (acct_9z12). Customer says the chart goes briefly below 0 then back to normal :confused: they raised a ticket.
Juan (Console): can you paste a screenshot and the exact route/model they used? Is this only in the dashboard or also in the raw timeseries API?
Maya (Support): screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/abc123 (from the user). They call our streaming endpoint /v1/stream with model=redwood-3b and they stream responses. The raw timeseries query to /analytics/streams?account=acct_9z12 shows points at t=1700..1705 with tokens_per_sec: [120, -45, 130]. So it's in both UI and API.
Lisa (Customer Success): customer repro steps (from their side):
1) open websocket to wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-3b&session=xyz
2) send 3 short prompts quickly (within same second)
3) watch Console -> Streaming -> tokens/sec for that session
They can consistently trigger a negative reading when they send short bursts.
Juan (Console): thanks — that helps. @Sriram can you check the metrics ingest/aggregation? It smells like a delta/time calc bug when delta_time is very small or zero.
Sriram (Eng-Metrics): looking at aggregator logs for that account/time window. I pulled the raw events from the ingest topic and here's a typical pair of events:
```
{ "ts": 1748890100.001, "tokens_emitted": 240 }
{ "ts": 1748890100.001, "tokens_emitted": 195 }
```
So two events with identical timestamps (!) - likely from parallel workers merging. Current agg computes rate = (tokens_now - tokens_prev) / (ts_now - ts_prev). When ts delta == 0 we fall back to a tiny epsilon, but there's also an ordering flip sometimes where tokens counter can decrease due to per-worker counters being independent, producing negative delta_tokens.
Sriram (Eng-Metrics): root cause hypothesis: per-shard counters are not normalized before reduction; when two shards with slightly different counters arrive out of order and same ts, the reduction yields negative token delta. The aggregator doesn't clamp negative rates, so tokens/sec shows negative values in both API and UI.
Maya (Support): customer is worried this will affect billing/alerts. Confirming: billing is computed from raw token totals server-side (not the derived tokens/sec), so billing should be unaffected, but visibility/alerts can be misleading.
Lisa (Customer Success): customer asks for mitigation timeline.
Sriram (Eng-Metrics): short-term mitigation: clamp runtime metric to >= 0 in the aggregator and in the view layer. Patch snippet:
```
// metrics-agg pseudocode
delta_tokens = tokens_now - tokens_prev
delta_t = max(ts_now - ts_prev, 1e-6)
tokens_per_sec = max(0, delta_tokens / delta_t)
```
I'll open a PR to metrics-agg and another to console to ensure UI clamps negative values and annotates repaired points.
Juan (Console): also add a transient tooltip explaining 'negative values are clamped due to parallel shard reconciliation' so customers don't misread.
ingest-bot: ALERT: 3 duplicate timestamps detected in topic streaming-events shard-7 between offsets 34200-34205 (investigate ordering guarantees)
Sriram (Eng-Metrics): long-term fix: we need to normalize per-shard counters to a monotonic global counter (or attach per-shard monotonic sequence numbers plus a reconciliation step) before computing deltas. I'll propose adding a small windowed reorder buffer that merges events deterministically.
Maya (Support): can we reproduce locally? Lisa, can the customer share a minimal repro websocket payload? If yes, we'll run it in staging and collect detailed logs.
Lisa (Customer Success): customer sent minimal repro: they will share a short script, dropping it into the ticket.
Maya (Support): ACTIONS ->
- Sriram: PR to clamp negative rates in metrics-agg + console patch (hotfix). Please include tests that simulate same-timestamp events and out-of-order shard counters. ETA 6 hours for hotfix.
- Juan: add UI clamp and tooltip. ETA 1 business day if hotfix can't deploy before EOD.
- Lisa: confirm customer that billing unaffected and we have a hotfix plan. Provide repro to eng if they can.
Sriram (Eng-Metrics): quick test in staging: I replayed the duplicate-timestamp events and after clamping the series shows 120, 0, 130 (no negative). Patch ready in my branch, running CI now.
Maya (Support): I'll update the ticket and mark as P1 until hotfix is live. If anyone hits blockers ping me.
Juan (Console): noted. I'll queue the tooltip work as follow-up.
Maya (Support): thanks team :thumbsup: will post status here when deploy goes out.
